test_title: PYST 233: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 15th Dec,, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

It didn’t dawn on me __until much later__ that he doesn’t like me.
solution:
The correct answer is **No substitution required.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is **grammatically correct.**
 
• Until much later is used in **the sense that it is not very late.**
 
• Another **example** of until much later is, "*The result of the examination was not revealed until much later.*"
